****Training \& Capacity Building Lead****
**Job Title:** 
 Training and Capacity Building Lead
   

  

**Location:** 
 UAE
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 CEO
   

  

**Overview** 
 :
   

  

 The Training \& Capacity Building \- Lead is responsible for leading the execution, management, and operational delivery of all training programs within the New Economy Academy (NEA). The role focuses on transforming strategic programs into high\-quality learning experiences through effective planning, coordination, stakeholder management, delivery oversight, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This role ensures the smooth execution of NEA's programs across areas such as entrepreneurship, financial literacy, new economy skills, leadership, specialized programs, and government capacity\-building initiatives. The position requires strong operational leadership, project execution capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously while maintaining excellence in participant experience and partner engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Execution \& Delivery**
* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of all NEA training and capacity\-building programs.
* Ensure programs are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and expected quality standards.
* Oversee operational planning for all training activities including schedules, venues, LMS coordination, trainers, logistics, assessments, certifications, and participant management.
* Monitor day\-to\-day execution of ongoing programs and proactively resolve operational challenges.
* Ensure alignment between program objectives, learning outcomes, and execution plans.
* Develop execution frameworks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and operational workflows for efficient program delivery.
* Ensure proper coordination between internal teams, trainers, partners, and external vendors.


**Training Operations Management**
* Manage the full training operations cycle from onboarding participants to post\-program reporting and closure.
* Supervise training coordinators, program coordinators, and operational support teams.
* Ensure all stakeholders are updated regularly on program progress, timelines, risks, and deliverables.
* Maintain high standards for participant experience and engagement throughout the training journey.
* Ensure training materials, attendance records, evaluations, and assessments are properly managed and documented.
* Ensure compliance with KHDA and any accreditation or regulatory requirements related to training delivery.


**Stakeholder \& Partner Coordination**
* Act as the main focal point for operational coordination with government entities, corporate clients, universities, trainers, and strategic partners.
* Coordinate with the Strategy \& Business Development team to ensure smooth transition from client acquisition to program implementation.
* Participate in client meetings, kick\-off sessions, and program review meetings when required.
* Build strong relationships with trainers, facilitators, and ecosystem partners to ensure high\-quality delivery standards.


**Team Leadership \& Performance Management**
* Lead and mentor the Training \& Capacity Building team to ensure high performance and accountability.
* Assign responsibilities clearly and monitor execution effectiveness across all running programs.
* Foster a collaborative, agile, and execution\-focused culture within the department.
* Support team development through coaching, guidance, and performance management.


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Monitor participant feedback and program performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Develop reports and dashboards to track program performance, attendance, satisfaction, and impact.
* Continuously improve operational efficiency, learning delivery models, and participant engagement approaches.
* Ensure programs maintain high standards aligned with NEA's vision and positioning.


**Requirements**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Education, Project Management, Human Capital, or related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.
* Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in training operations, learning management, capacity building, or program execution.
* Experience managing large\-scale government or corporate training programs is highly preferred.
* Strong project management and operational execution experience.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong operational execution and organizational skills.
* Excellent project and program management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* High adaptability in fast\-paced and dynamic environments.
* Strong reporting and coordination capabilities.

**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.
* Established relationships with key regional rail clients, authorities or delivery partners would be advantageous.

The role collaborates with corporate functions and resort teams to ensure that customer journey principles are embedded into new projects, brand initiatives, operational processes, and service culture across the portfolio.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement the brand’s guest experience and customer journey strategy across all properties and touchpoints.
* Define and continuously refine the ideal end\-to\-end guest journey, ensuring alignment with the brand vision, values, and positioning.
* Lead the development of guest experience standards, emotional touchpoints, rituals, and service moments that create memorable experiences.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, personalize, and improve the guest journey.
* Ensure consistency in guest experience delivery across all resorts, residences, clubs, and other brand offerings.
* Map and document guest journeys for key customer segments and personas.
* Identify pain points, gaps, and opportunities across the customer lifecycle.
* Partner with operational and functional teams to implement improvements and monitor effectiveness.
* Lead projects related to guest journey redesign, service innovation, digital integration, and process enhancement.
* Ensure guest journey considerations are embedded into new openings, renovations, systems, and business initiatives.
* Oversee the collection, analysis, and interpretation of guest feedback from surveys, reviews, social media, direct comments, mystery audits, and other channels.
* Use guest insight data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop dashboards, reporting tools, and presentations to communicate guest experience performance and key priorities.
* Benchmark against competitors and luxury hospitality best practices.
* Support properties with action plans related to guest satisfaction, reputation management, and service recovery.
* Collaborate with Brand, Quality, and Operations teams to ensure that guest experience standards are clearly defined and embedded.
* Ensure brand standards remain relevant, guest\-centric, and aligned with evolving market expectations.
* Support the development and review of operating procedures, guidelines, and service standards.
* Participate in resort visits, quality audits, and guest experience reviews.
* Promote consistency while respecting local culture, market conditions, and guest demographics.
* Work closely with Digital, IT, CRM, and Marketing teams to improve digital guest touchpoints and enhance personalization.
* Support the integration of technology that enhances the guest experience, such as mobile check\-in, guest apps, CRM tools, AI\-enabled communication, and digital concierge services.
* Monitor guest behavior trends and emerging technologies that can improve service delivery and guest engagement.
* Encourage innovation and creative thinking across the organization to continuously evolve the customer journey.
* Build strong relationships with resort leadership teams and functional stakeholders.
* Provide guidance, coaching, and support to teams involved in guest experience initiatives.
* Lead cross\-functional working groups and committees focused on guest journey enhancement.
* Act as a subject matter expert for guest experience, customer journey, and service culture.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and guest\-centric thinking.


**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
* 8–10 years of experience in luxury hospitality operations, guest experience, customer journey, brand, quality, or service excellence roles
* Proven experience in customer journey mapping, guest experience design, service innovation, and guest satisfaction improvement within luxury hospitality
* Strong understanding of luxury guest expectations, emotional touchpoints, and end\-to\-end customer journey management
* Experience in guest feedback analysis, reputation management, Net Promoter Score (NPS), and guest satisfaction metrics
* Knowledge of guest personalization, CRM systems, loyalty programs, and VIP guest relationship management
* Experience in designing and implementing guest experience initiatives across multiple touchpoints including pre\-arrival, stay, and post\-stay
* Background in service culture, training, coaching, and cross\-functional collaboration within hospitality environments
* Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Customer Experience, or a related field required
* Additional certifications in Customer Experience, Service Design, Luxury Hospitality, Brand Strategy, or Project Management preferred
* Understanding of digital guest touchpoints, AI, CRM tools, and technology applications in guest personalization and service delivery
* Knowledge of luxury travel trends, guest expectations, and competitive benchmarking


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

**Account Director – Social, Content, Influencer \& Performance** 




**Company:** 
 Techne Agency
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai (Managing a UK team) / Hybrid or Remote (with travel when required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Start Date:** 
 Q3 2026
 



  





**About Techne Agency** 





 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and website content, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 





 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and technology, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record of results across the UK, UAE and Europe.
 





 Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European and UAE markets. This international footprint allows us to combine cultural relevance, creative execution and performance expertise across multiple markets.
 





 As the agency continues to grow, we are building a senior leadership layer to support this expansion. We are looking for someone who can help shape the future of the business, elevate our standards and play a key role in delivering exceptional work across all clients.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We're looking for a senior operator to lead client delivery across the agency and act as the right hand to the Founder \& CEO.
 





 This is a pivotal role within Techne, offering the opportunity to take ownership of high\-profile client relationships, shape the quality and direction of our work, and build a delivery function designed to scale.
 





 This is not a traditional account management role. You will operate across multiple disciplines — combining strategic oversight, team leadership and hands\-on execution to ensure consistently exceptional output. You'll manage the team, own the day\-to\-day, and be the person who keeps everything moving to a high standard.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Leadership** 



* Own senior client relationships across our European and UAE portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for strategy, performance and escalation
* Lead communication and direction across retainers and projects, ensuring accounts are proactively managed
* Identify and drive growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new business where relevant
* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

data.jd_text:
At Genius we are hiring for a role of
 **Manager Operations\-\-Home Delivery** 
 for a leading FMCG client
 



**Location Dubai** 




 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Delivery Operations Management
 


* Oversee and manage end\-to\-end delivery operations across all outlets and brands.

* Maintain delivery infrastructure readiness, including staffing, systems, packaging, and logistics processes.
* Monitor and improve operational KPIs including SLA adherence, delivery delays, cancellations, refunds, customer ratings, and order accuracy.

* Monitor promotional campaigns, marketing activities, and platform visibility.

* Monitor customer feedback trends and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate documentation, tracking, and resolution of customer feedback and service issues.

 5\. Reporting \& Analytics

* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for business improvement.
* Develop dashboards and performance tracking mechanisms to support data\-driven decision\-making.



 6\. Compliance \& Quality Assurance
 


* Ensure adherence to company policies, operational standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular audits and compliance checks across all delivery operations.

 7\. Contract Management
 


* Manage contracts and agreements with delivery aggregators, logistics providers, and external partners.

* Ensure all agreements align with company objectives and operational requirements.



 8\. Strategic Planning \& Expansion
 


* Support new outlet openings, market expansions, and brand launches.
* Conduct feasibility studies and operational assessments for new delivery initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to long\-term delivery growth strategies and business development initiatives.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Delivery sales and order growth
* SLA and delivery time adherence
* Customer satisfaction and ratings
* Order accuracy and cancellation rates
* Refund and complaint reduction
* Cost control and operational efficiency
* Campaign performance and ROI
* Aggregator relationship performance
* Profitability of delivery operations



 Qualifications \& Requirements
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in delivery operations, food service, QSR, or multi\-unit operations management.
* Strong understanding of delivery aggregators, food delivery platforms, and logistics operations.
* Proven experience in KPI management, sales growth, and operational optimization.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and operational dashboards.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-market environment.

**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction

 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.

**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. **Job Summary** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager for Renewables and Batteries will provide and coordinate technical and engineering input into the identification, due diligence, development, and delivery of utility scale renewable energy projects (wind, solar, BESS and hybrid) in feasibility stage, development stage, and tender/bid stage. These technical and engineering inputs will include technology selection, balance of plant design, grid connection works, development of technical documentation to support procurement activities, and overview of installation, construction, commissioning, testing of works, warranty and operational support of existing and new projects.
 



  





  





**Reporting** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager Renewables will be part of the Engineering and Technical Support (ETS) team for Renewables and Batteries within the GCC and will report to the Head of Engineering MENA.
 



  





  





**Key Accountabilities** 




 • Manage and coordinate engineering work packages with respect to choice of technologies, technical configurations and for setting relevant performance, statutory, safety and quality requirements.
 



 • In charge of all aspects and documentation of the contractual negotiations during Business Development of all O\&M and/or Technical\-related agreements: EPC, EPCM, PPA, OE, LTSA, etc.
 



 • Work closely with the procurement and construction team in line with the procurement strategies and construction strategies.
 



 • Be responsible for drafting/contributing to and negotiating owner specifications, including the incorporation of the latest group experience and standards.
 



 • Prepare Capex and O\&M budgets integrating feedback from Group assets and Group specialists.
 



 • Prepare all O\&M technical related documents for the bid (OM organization chart, O\&M references, O\&M Philosophy, etc.).
 



 • Interface with Lender's Engineer and support Lenders’ due diligence during closing process.
 



 • Management of internal approval process (O\&M and Technical).
 



 • Support of CEO and Construction Managers of Project Companies or CEO and Plant Managers of O\&M Companies, for punctual problems during construction, commissioning phase and during operations.
 



 • Perform technology watch and share knowledge within the ETS team
 



  





  





**Degree / Experience** 




 • Degree in an engineering discipline, bachelors or masters
 



 • Minimum of 15 years of experience in the power generation sector with specific knowledge, expertise and experience in developing or constructing solar PV and/or BESS projects including the ability to:
 



 o evaluate and perform feasibility studies
 



 o conduct technology configurations

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a Resident Architect to join our DSA team in Dubai.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview**




  





 To lead the on\-site architectural supervision and consultant services for major construction projects. This includes the administration of post\-contract responsibilities as defined by the appointment, managing and coordinating multidisciplinary site teams where applicable, ensuring alignment with the approved design intent, and monitoring compliance with the project’s contract, codes, and specifications. When appointed in a Design Guardian capacity, the role is limited to safeguarding the design intent through review, coordination, and advisory input only, and does not include construction supervision, inspection, certification, contract administration, or Defects Liability Period services unless expressly agreed and appointed under a separate scope. The role serves as a primary interface between the client, contractors, design teams, and other stakeholders. The exact scope of services may differ on a project\-by\-project basis and will be further defined as part of the project\-specific deliverables..
 



  





**2\.Job Accountabilities Linked To Objectives**




  





 The Resident Architect is responsible for leading the on\-site project team and driving the successful delivery of the project. As the most senior project representative for DSA on site, this role carries the critical responsibility of safeguarding the company’s interests, contractual, legal, and commercial responsibilities throughout the construction phase and ensuring the project aligns with DSA’s standards and obligations.
 



  





 The Resident Architect may be assigned responsibilities across one or multiple projects, as well as strategic or special initiatives aligned with the company's broader objectives. These special assignments may extend beyond project\-specific duties and can include tasks such as conducting quality audits, developing procedures, manuals and supporting internal process improvements \& development.
 



  





 In all cases, the Resident Architect is expected to work closely, not only with their direct team/ the Client but also with their immediate supervisor and line manager to clearly define the scope of responsibilities, deliverables, and resource requirements specific to each assignment. The final scope of duties and level of authority will be established in consultation with and subject to approval by the Site Operations Director, Project Director or relevant senior leadership.
 



  





**A. Design Site Leadership** 




 • Lead the site\-based lead consultancy team (where present) to ensure high standards of quality, compliance, coordination, and delivery across all stakeholders, proactively addressing deficiencies as they arise.
 



 • Oversee and assist with design deliverables, pre\-engineering, shop drawings, RFIs, submittals, inspections, and construction queries to support timely resolution and adherence to project requirements.
 



 • Review and approve works, including but not limited to mock\-ups, sample rooms, materials, and finishes, ensuring alignment with the approved design / designer, specifications, and project requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective design coordination across all disciplines and contribute to the resolution of design and construction\-related conflicts.
 



 • Conduct regular architectural and design\-focused site walks to monitor the implementation of the approved design intent, including look, feel, materiality, and spatial quality.
 



 • Identify, document, and report design, aesthetic, and quality\-related risks or non\-compliances to the LDC / Client through structured observations and reporting.
 



 • Prepare and issue monthly architectural / design guardianship reports summarising site observations, key risks, and matters requiring attention.
 



 • Review and provide comments on material samples, mock\-ups, mood boards, finishes, look \& feel assessments, and sample rooms to support alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Provide architectural and interior design clarifications, including aesthetic and design intent matters, where requested by the Client.
 



 • Participate in value engineering and design development discussions, providing input on architectural quality, aesthetic impact, and alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Coordinate closely with PMCM, the Contractor, and the wider consultant team during site reviews, technical meetings, and design discussions to maintain alignment between design intent, construction execution, and client expectations.
 



 • Monitor that the executed works reflect the approved design, client expectations, and applicable codes and regulations throughout the construction process.
 



 • Ensure RFIs, approvals, instructions, and IFC changes are managed through the established project communication and authority channels and are properly coordinated across all parties.
 



 • Produce and issue timely internal and external dashboards capturing progress, quality, design alignment, and emerging risks.
 



  





**B. Site Supervision Team Management** 




 • Direct and manage the day\-to\-day performance of DSA's site supervision team (architects, engineers, inspectors, sub\-consultants and the like).
 



 • Ensure all team members are properly briefed on their roles and responsibilities.
 



 • Implement structured delegation and reporting mechanisms.
 



 • Conduct periodic audits, QA/QC / technical reviews, and performance assessments.
 



 • Maintain a collaborative, professional, and high\-performing supervision environment on site.
 



 • Ensure employees / team members conduct are upheld to the highest standards
 



 • Monitor and update in coordination with the Client and Site Operations Director the project, staff deployment, associated schedule and ensure timely delivery of the same at the agreed frequency
 



  





**C. Project \& Contract Administration** 




 • Oversee compliance with the project’s construction contract (FIDIC or equivalent).
 



 • Issue formal communications, manage variations, evaluate contractor claims, and contribute to extension of time assessments.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation, records \& communication protocols are established, used and maintained for all supervision activities.
 



 • Coordinate with the Employer’s Representative and Client\-appointed Consultants.
 



 • Act as Engineer’s Representative / Employer’s Representative if appointed, ensuring responsibilities are discharged in line with the delegated authority.
 



 • Assist in stake holder and lead in team dispute resolution
 



  





**D. Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Interface** 




 • Act as the senior site representative of the lead consultant.
 



 • Establish and manage coordination mechanisms among the consultant team, contractor, suppliers, and client representatives.
 



 • Participate in progress meetings, site coordination meetings, and technical reviews.
 



 • Monitor and steer project progress and associated scheduling and produce relevant reports
 



 • Provide strategic input and advice to the client to ensure project objectives are met.
 



  





**E. Quality \& Compliance Oversight** 




 • Enforce quality control standards and escalate issues that risk the design quality or compliance of the project / deliverables
 



 • Monitor health, safety, and environmental practices on site.
 



 • Participate in final inspections, testing, and commissioning phases.
 



 • Ensure defect lists, non\-conformance reports and site observations are compiled and rectified in line with contract obligations.
 



 • Ensure pre\-engineering deliverables are in line with contract agreement and implement measures to maintain and or rectify resulting shortfalls
 



 • Monitor and advise on change control process
 



  





**F. Leadership \& Mentorship** 




 • Serve as mentor and technical advisor to staff, engineers and sub\-consultants.
 



 • Lead internal training and onboarding of new site staff.
 



 • Foster a knowledge\-sharing culture that emphasizes continuous improvement and professional development to the benefit of the project and company.
 



  





**G. Commercial \& Invoicing Responsibilities** 




 • Coordinate with the head office/accounts team to prepare and validate monthly consultancy service invoices in line with contract terms.
 



 • Review and confirm site\-based and related staff, timesheets for inclusion in monthly billing.
 



 • Collect, verify, and consolidate sub\-consultant timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and scope alignment.
 



 • Track sub\-consultant invoices and ensure timely submission to accounts for processing.
 



 • Maintain a project\-specific log of all invoicing activities, including issue dates, payment terms, and receipt confirmations amongst others.
 



 • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with clients and relevant stakeholders to ensure prompt payment.
 



 • Flag and escalate delays in payment or disputed invoices to the Project Director and commercial team.
 



 • Liaise with sub\-consultants regarding their payment status and provide updates on payment cycles and client approvals.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal financial procedures and contractual invoicing requirements.
 



 • Support monthly project \& financial reporting with updates on invoice status, forecasted income, and payment risks.
 



 • Assist in reconciling client payment records with internal accounts to resolve discrepancies, if any.
 



 • Track any approved variations or scope changes and coordinate with the commercial team to ensure these are invoiced accordingly.
 



  





**3\. Qualification / Experience / Requirements**




  





 • Qualified Architect (BArch / MArch) with minimum 15 years’ experience; at least 10 years on\-site in the Middle East.
 



 • Proven experience as a Resident Architect on large\-scale or complex projects.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of FIDIC contract administration and construction management practices.
 



 • Experience managing multidisciplinary supervision teams in fast\-track environments.
 



 • Familiar with UAE/ Regional Authority codes, regulations, and approval procedures.
 



 • PMP, MCIOB, or similar certifications are advantageous.
 



 • Strong documentation, reporting, technical and problem\-solving capabilities.
 



  





 Interested candidates can share their resume directly on recruit.dxb@dsa\-arch.com mentioning "Resident Architect" as a subject.

data.jd_text:
**General Description**
 The position is responsible for supporting Chief Risk Officer / HEAD GRCI for all aspects of the risk delivery. The DGM is also responsible for supporting the CRO/HEAD GRCI in overseeing the daily operations and overall management of the Division. The DGM ensures that GRCI agendas are met efficiently, while maintaining high standards of performance, operational effectiveness and divisional growth in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI. The person will work closely with CRO/HEAD GRCI, implementing Enterprise Risk Management Framework focusing on Tier 1 \& 2 risk reporting i.e. Strategic, Operational, Projects \& Investment Risks. The person shall also assist the CRO / HEAD in other strategic initiatives. The person shall coordinate with other functional areas in the Company to ensure all risks in the Company are identified, measured, mitigated/managed, and monitored/reported. On top of that, the person shall ensure insurance adequacy and address all queries on all lines of insurances promptly.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Collaborate with the CRO/HEAD GRCI, to adapt and implement Group risk policies, frameworks, and operating models tailored to organizational needs.
* Assist the CRO/HEAD GRCI in preparing and managing matters reported to Risk, Sustainability and Governance (RSGC) Committee reporting. Responsibilities include drafting Agenda, tracking and addressing Matters Arising, preparing and reviewing reports such as Risk Management Report, Group Technology Reports, Sustainability Report and Other Agenda Papers (Hospital License, Anti\- Bribery Management System (ABMS), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Report from Medical Advisory Committee (GMACCG), Key Sentinel/Major Incidents quarterly reporting and other papers required by RSGC.
* Identify key risks and their indicators in risk reporting and monitoring, oversee the development and execution of mitigation plans.
* Lead the end to end risk management process for KPJ in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI which includes an analysis of the financial and non\-financial impact when risks occur.
* Lead the end\-to\-end risk management process in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI, including identifying, quantifying, mitigating, and monitoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, project and investment risks).
* To partner with the Head of Group Services and Head of Business Units to ensure that all Risks (Tier 1 \& 2\) risks including investment, project risks, top risk and top emerging risks are being considered in their strategic or operational initiatives. This also includes ESG \& ABC risk identification and mitigation, implementation of appropriate risk management systems and loss event database are properly identified, quantified, managed and monitored.
* Partner and collaborate with other Line of Defence including Group Legal \& Advisory Services (GLAS), Group Clinical (GC), Internal Audit Services (IAS), Compliance \& Integrity Unit within GRCI and Group Sustainability Services (GSS) to to drive implementation of integrated risk management framework.
* Key activities include:
* Regularly updating and monitoring high\-risk medical malpractice active cases and sentinel events at hospitals that could result in viral or reputational damage.
* Coordinating with Internal Audit to synchronize audit plans and analyze findings for actionable insights.
* Collaborating with the Compliance and Integrity Unit to identify and address top risks and emerging ABC (Anti\-Bribery and Corruption) risks effectively.
* Ensuring the adoption and integration of appropriate risk management systems and maintaining a comprehensive loss event database for enhanced risk visibility and mitigation.
* To review and provide an independent assessment view on the key risks associated with projects \& investment undertaken with focus on Investment Risks.
* To review and challenge the proposals submitted by Hospitals or Subsidiaries on investment of new towers, renovations, major acquisition of assets and divestments by assessing their assumptions, investment costs, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, stress testing to evaluate the project resilience under various market conditions.
* Be the subject matter expert and change agent on ERM.
* Review the key risks associated with proposed major investments and projects (M\&As).
* Perform horizon scanning to identify emerging risks which may impact the organisation arising from changes in the external environment.
* Highlight emerging risks through flash report and emerging risk updates.
* Drive and champion risk initiatives/ innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
* leveraging analytics, machine learning and automation.
* Champion innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
* Use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to anticipate risks, especially for high\-impact areas like market changes, operational disruptions, or cybersecurity.
* Create a real\-time, enterprise\-wide dashboard that consolidates all key risk metrics for better oversight and transparency.
* Develop and deliver outreach and engagement activities in support of embedding and strengthening risk management culture and awareness.
* Engage more deeply with middle management and front\-line staff to embed risk awareness and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Delivering impactful risk management training.
* Recommend professional certifications and ERM training syllabus for skill enhancement among ERM professionals.
* Encourage your team to pursue certifications in advanced risk management, sustainability, or digital tools to improve their skillsets.
* Actively participate in risk forums and discussions with senior management to align risk strategies with business goal.
* Other business units/functions – Execute and deliver initiatives on a regular basis to identify unique/emerging risks and design risk management strategies to address the risks identified.
* Perform adhoc independent risk review and validation for any request on Group’s undertakings.
* Develop ERM risk reporting/dashboard, timely communicate/escalate risk events, issues, and compliance with risk policies and limits to key stakeholders in the Company and in the region; manage the Company’s quarterly risk reporting.
* Regularly review the Risk Management framework and the operating structure for identifying, assessing, managing and monitoring the risks.
* Execute the annual Risk Management processes with key business, stakeholders, update the risk assessment and ensure adequate measures are in place to mitigate the identified risks.
* Monitor the risk appetite, identifying key risk management strategies, assessing and profiling of the key risks affecting the achievement of the business plans at group, business division and at a department level.
* Develop, refine and review the Risk Register and evaluate the relevance of risks identified across business units in the Group.
* Assist Senior Management team in improving risk management / mitigating strategies and techniques, and carrying out follow up action plans and its effectiveness in mitigating / controlling risks.
* Review and evaluate the effectiveness of implementation of action plans for risk management \- provide assurance on whether the risk mitigation process is being driven effectively and efficiently, whilst also continuously monitoring of whether the risk register is being updated appropriately.
* Evaluate and draw attention to possible gaps in the risk register to the Senior Management and Head of Services \- follow\-up on the development of control environment to overcome deficiencies in the risk management / mitigating process.
* Collaborate working with relevant functions (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Finance and Legal) to build up and/or implement a risk control framework (i.e. compliance self\-assessment) and provide quality and solutions\-focused advice on risk and control issues relevant to the business division for informed decision\-making on compliance and ethics matters.
* Align ERM practices more closely with KPJ’s long\-term strategic objectives, Academic Health System, Center of Excellence, digital transformation and market expansion.
* Review and challenge the Annual Strategic Planning initiatives and monitor the execution of strategies closely.
* Collaborate closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to address the increasing threat of data breaches and cyberattacks.
* Direct engagement and review on insurance related queries on medical malpractise, general, directors \& liabilities and other lines of insurance coverage.
* Assess and review the adequacy of insurance coverage on an annual basis and present to relevant Committees for renewal.
* To systematically strategize to ensure effectiveness in handling incidents, ensuring a proactive and efficient approach to incident resolution at the Hospital and/or HQ to avoid escalation of incident into crisis.
* To continuously conduct coaching/guidance through on the job training and regular one to one session.
* Act as a key support to the CRO/HEAD GRCI in representing the GRCI in board meetings, committees, and industry forums
* Represent the CRO/HEAD in Management meetings, committees, or forums when required.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the design and implementation of compliance programs that align with local and international regulations.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI in ensure effective monitoring of compliance risks, including anti\-money laundering (AML), anti\-bribery and corruption (ABC) and data privacy.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to develop and promote a robust integrity framework, ensuring the organization adheres to ethical standards and best practices.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the implementation of whistleblowing mechanisms, ethics training programs, and conflict of interest management processes.
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of integrity initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational values in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting/Finance
* Chartered Accountant, Certified Risk Professional, Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) would be an added advantage
* ▪Minimum 15 years relevant working experience with minimum 5 years at Management Level
* Professional Paper, Career stint in a Big 4 accounting firm, Healthcare industry experience
* Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Investment \& Finance

data.jd_text:
**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you energized by partnering with senior leaders to enable business success through people\-focused solutions? As Head of HR, you will work closely with leaders and their leadership teams across the Middle East with focus on UAE and Saudi\-Arabia to support the delivery of the people agenda.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a trusted HR advisor on a broad range of people and organizational topics, helping leaders translate business priorities into effective people actions and play an important role in supporting leadership teams through change, organizational development, talent decisions, and workforce planning.
   

  

 This role combines senior HR partnering with hands\-on execution of (a.o.) HR cycle topics.
   

  

**What are my job responsibilities?**
**Strategic HR Leadership \& People Advisory**
* Act as a strategic advisor to Executive Management on all HR and workforce\-related matters
* Partner with leaders to design organizations that effectively support both operational and office\-based teams
* Translate business priorities into practical people\-centered actions that resonate across all workforce segments
* Lead employee relations initiatives, including dispute resolution and organizational interventions


**Workforce Planning, Talent \& Employee Lifecycle**
* Lead workforce planning aligned with business growth and operational realities
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle processes
* Partner with leadership on hiring strategies, workforce structures, and succession planning
* Ensure smooth onboarding and integration, especially for expatriate and site\-based employees
* Ensure attraction, development, and retention of talent while maintaining workforce stability


**Employee Relations, Labour Law \& Compliance**
* Manage employee relations and labor matters in line with UAE \& KSA labor laws
* Act as a key point of contact for complex employee relations matters, with strong on\-the\-ground involvement
* Build trust with blue\-collar employees through visibility, accessibility, and consistent communication
* Support leaders in resolving employee issues, conflicts, and workplace challenges
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant HR practices
* Develop and implement HR policies and conduct audits to ensure governance and continuous improvement


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Implement performance management practices aligned with business goals
* Support leaders in driving performance through effective people management
* Drive career development, succession planning, and talent initiatives
* Foster a high\-performance culture while ensuring employee engagement and sustainable workloads


**Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Value Proposition**
* Design and manage competitive compensation and benefits structures
* Lead salary benchmarking, job evaluations, and incentive programs
* Enhance benefits and offerings to meet both organizational and employee needs


**HR Operations, Systems \& Employee Experience**
* Oversee HR operations including HRIS, payroll coordination, and employee records
* Ensure smooth delivery of employee services (facilities, travel, housing, etc.)
* Manage HR systems, reporting, and workforce analytics
* Drive efficient processes while maintaining a positive employee experience


**HR Transformation, Projects \& Change Management**
* Lead HR transformation and digitalization initiatives
* Manage HR projects end\-to\-end, ensuring delivery and impact
* Drive change management with strong focus on communication, adoption, and employee impact
* Ensure change initiatives are clearly communicated and understood by all workforce segments, including non\-office employees
* Define and track KPIs to measure both business and people outcomes


**What do I need to qualify for this role?**
* Strong experience in an HR Business Partner or HR leadership role, preferably in a global or matrixed organization
* Experience partnering with senior leaders on people, workforce, and organizational topics
* Experience managing large blue\-collar or operational workforce populations
* Proven experience in employee relations, labor law, and workforce management
* Experience supporting organizational change and leadership decision\-making
* A collaborative style and confidence working across all levels


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field (master’s preferred)
* 12–15 years of HR experience, including 5\+ years in a leadership role within UAE \& KSA
* Strong knowledge of UAE \& KSA Labor Law
* Experience in HR transformation and project management


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and business acumen
* Leadership and stakeholder management
* Change management and transformation expertise
* Communication and influencing skills
* Strong business understanding and the ability to translate business priorities into people actions
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities an end\-to\-end experience which anchors improved performance
* A pragmatic, resilient, and solutions\-oriented mindset
* The ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast\-changing environment


**About The Team**
 You will report to Global HR BP ICS of VL and work closely with the regional VL and VI HR colleagues, and HR Functions and HR Service team.

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




 This marketing agency is hiring a commercially minded, hands\-on Media Strategist to own and scale paid campaigns across Google and Meta, while supporting expansion into new platforms.
 



 As a UK\-headquartered business operating globally, strong professional English communication is essential.
 



 You will take full ownership of assigned products, accountable for lead volume, CPA, quality, and margin performance. Reporting to the Head of Media, you’ll execute strategy while driving day\-to\-day optimisation and growth.
 



 This is a delivery\-focused role with clear commercial performance expectations — not a coordination position.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Owns paid media strategy and execution for assigned products
* Builds, launches, and scales campaigns across Google Ads and Meta
* Manages performance against clear CPA, ROAS, and margin targets
* Monitors campaigns daily and makes decisive optimisation changes
* Tests new creative approaches, audiences, bidding models, and landing page strategies
* Develops and iterates ad copy across Google and Meta, including RSA headline and description variants, Meta primary text and CTAs, and landing page messaging
* Briefs creative assets with clear strategic rationale and systematically tests messaging hypotheses using performance data to inform future iterations
* Contributes to expansion into new platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Native, and Programmatic where commercially justified
* Collaborates closely with Tech, Ops, and Content teams to improve lead quality and conversion efficiency
* Uses data to generate insights by identifying trends, diagnosing issues, and proposing clear action plans
* Leverages generative AI tools to research products and markets, generate insights, and analyse campaign data to identify efficiency gains and commercial opportunities
* Provides structured and concise performance reporting to the Head of Media



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Has 3–7 years of experience managing paid media campaigns, with strong hands\-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta (5\+ years preferred)
* Demonstrates proven experience running lead generation campaigns with clear commercial accountability
* Has a strong track record of working against strict CPA and performance targets
* Possesses strong analytical capability and is comfortable working with performance data on a daily basis
* Demonstrates strong commercial awareness, with a clear understanding that success is measured by profitability and scalability rather than traffic alone
* Brings experience across additional platforms such as Bing, YouTube, Native, TikTok, and similar channels, which is considered advantageous
* Has experience marketing within regulated sectors such as financial services, insurance, legal, or healthcare; familiarity with FCA advertising standards or equivalent is highly advantageous
* Actively uses generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent platforms as part of daily workflow, including copy generation, creative briefing, performance analysis, and reporting
* Demonstrates exceptional written and spoken English fluency at a business and client\-ready level
* Has experience marketing products within the UK or other native English\-speaking markets, which is considered highly advantageous
* Exhibits a high\-ownership mentality and thrives in a results\-driven environment
* Is most likely currently based in Dubai, although exceptional candidates requiring relocation support may also be considered



  





**What the company offers:** 



* Offers a competitive salary alongside a monthly performance\-based bonus structure typically valued at approximately 15% of gross salary
* Provides clear performance accountability with strong opportunities for career progression
* Enables direct involvement in strategic decision\-making across multiple verticals, supported by a short reporting line and genuine commercial ownership of accounts from day one
* Presents a high\-impact, high\-autonomy role within a growing media team
* Supports a flexible working culture, including remote working where appropriate
* Offers the opportunity to work within a business actively investing in innovation and AI\-enabled marketing

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  




  


**Please apply directly through with your application and kindly only contact our Recruitment team for any further details, legal experiance is essential part of the criteria for this role.**
  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.
   

  

 •Maintain close and regular communication with HR throughout the performance review cycle, ensuring awareness of progress, confirming deadlines, understanding process or system changes, and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 CRM \& Relationship Management
   

  

 •Maintain and update the Head of Middle East’s contacts and relationship data in InterAction, ensuring activities, meetings and relationship notes are accurately recorded.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in managing and maintaining effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers, supporting collaboration across jurisdictions.
   

  

 •Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring referrals are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in ensuring referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow‑up on agreed actions and opportunities.
