data.jd_text:
**About Yellow Door Energy**
 Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability, and lower carbon emissions.
   

  

 Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy, and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui \& Co, TAEF, and the International Finance Corporation.
   

  

 🔍 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Renewable Energy PV Project Manager – KSA** 
 to support the delivery of commercial and industrial solar PV projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Experience with
 **BESS or hybrid energy projects** 
 would be a strong advantage.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on project delivery role focused on the site\-based execution of solar PV projects from mobilisation, EPC and subcontractor coordination, progress tracking, and project controls through to quality inspections, commissioning, documentation, and handover.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the VP of Execution, you will act as YDE’s on\-site representative, ensuring EPC contractors deliver safely, on schedule, within budget, and in line with YDE’s technical, contractual, HSE, and quality standards.
   

  

 This role is best suited to a project professional with strong solar PV construction experience, practical engineering knowledge, and the discipline to manage daily site execution, contractor performance, project controls, variations, and reporting in a fast\-moving, site\-based environment.
   

  

 ⚡ What You’ll Deliver \& Own
   

  

 In this role, you will support the successful delivery of commercial and industrial solar PV projects across KSA, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to YDE’s technical and quality standards.
   

  

**You Will**
* Drive day\-to\-day site execution, EPC and subcontractor coordination, progress tracking, and issue resolution.
* Translate approved PV designs, drawings, schedules, and project plans into contractor\-ready execution activities.
* Monitor EPC contractor and subcontractor performance, review look\-ahead schedules, challenge recovery plans, and maintain accurate site records.
* Support project controls and contract administration activities, including contractor payment application review, milestone tracking, variation inputs, and time/cost impact assessment.
* Track critical project controls, including RFIs, technical queries, drawing revisions, submittals, procurement dependencies, risks, costs, variations, and reporting.
* Support HSE leadership on site through toolbox talks, inspections, permit\-to\-work processes, incident reporting, and corrective action follow\-up.
* Conduct quality inspections at key hold points, including piling, racking, DC cabling, AC works, switchgear installation, and inverter commissioning.
* Support commissioning, punch\-list close\-out, handover documentation, and transition to Asset Management and O\&M teams.


 🛠️ What You Must Bring
   

  

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Must Have**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering preferred; Mechanical or Civil Engineering may also be considered.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in project management or site engineering for EPC/construction projects.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in solar PV or renewable energy projects.
* Hands\-on experience managing solar PV construction sites, including DC and AC electrical works, mounting structure installation, inverter commissioning, and grid interconnection.
* Strong experience coordinating EPC contractors and project subcontractors, including progress tracking, RFIs, submittals, variation inputs, payment application review, project documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Practical experience with PVsyst, MS Project or Primavera P6, and AutoCAD.
* Working knowledge of the KSA or regional construction environment, including SEC standards, municipality permit processes, and site safety regulations.
* Willingness to travel regularly to project sites across KSA.


**Strong Advantage**
 We would especially like to hear from candidates who also have:
   

  

* PMP, IPMA Level D/C, or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience delivering C\&I grid\-tied solar PV projects in the 1 MW–20 MW range.
* BESS or hybrid energy project experience.
* Arabic language skills or strong experience working in Arabic\-speaking site environments.


 You’ll Thrive Here If...
   

  

 You are likely to succeed in this role if you are a hands\-on project professional who is comfortable being close to the work, coordinating EPC contractors and site teams with technical credibility, and managing the detail required to deliver high\-quality solar PV projects.
   

  

**You Should Be Someone Who**
* Understands solar PV construction beyond high\-level project coordination.
* Is confident working regularly on project sites, not only from an office or PMO environment.
* Brings discipline in schedules, documentation, RFIs, submittals, variations, inspections, and commissioning records.
* Can track contractor performance, identify risks early, and escalate with practical mitigation options
* Cares deeply about HSE, quality, accountability, and delivery standards.
* Can balance urgency with structure, attention to detail, and collaborative communication.


 🌱 Why Join Us?
   

  

 At Yellow Door Energy, you’ll be part of a leading sustainable energy company delivering real impact across the Middle East and Africa.
   

  

 You’ll work on high\-impact solar PV and clean energy projects, alongside experienced renewable energy professionals, in a culture that values safety, ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 📩 Apply Now
   

  

 If you are a hands\-on solar PV project professional with strong EPC construction experience and the drive to deliver safe, high\-quality renewable energy projects in KSA, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Let’s lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.

**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**

* Develop and maintain a deep working knowledge of the ERP system and its finance modules — Accounting, Invoicing, Expenses, Payments, Reconciliation, Budgeting, Reporting, Tax, Multi\-company, Multi\-currency, and integrations with payment gateways and banks.
* Maintain a living catalogue of features, modules, and capabilities — including what is enabled, what is in use, what is configured but unused, and what exists in newer versions but has not been adopted.
* Stay current on ERP version roadmaps, release notes, and best practices — translate them into opportunities for Snoonu.
* Run structured discovery sessions with Finance, Treasury, FP\&A, Tax, and adjacent teams (Commercial, Operations) to map current processes against ERP capabilities.
* Identify and document: (a) capabilities we should be using but aren't, (b) features we use incorrectly, (c) manual workarounds that should live in the ERP, and (d) controls or audit requirements not yet enforced in the system.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of opportunities and issues, scored by impact, effort, risk, and dependencies.
* Own the ERP–Finance project portfolio end\-to\-end: intake, scoping, sprint planning, delivery, UAT, go\-live, and post\-launch measurement.
* Lead Sprint 0 artifacts for every initiative — Project Charter, Product Definition Document (PDD), Requirements \& Scope, Delivery \& Governance Plan — to the standard set by the team's SDLC framework.
* Coordinate with the Digital Solutions Lead and Engineers on technical delivery, integrations, customizations, and version upgrades.
* Govern ERP change requests: triage incoming asks, validate impact, ensure proper approvals, and manage release windows so finance close cycles are protected.
* Understand how ERP systems are architected — modules, configurations, customizations, and integrations — well enough to challenge scope, catch risks early, and make informed prioritization decisions.
* Be conversational with developers about APIs, data flows, integrations, and technical constraints. You don't write code, but you understand what is easy vs. complex, and why.
* Read and contribute to technical specs, review configurations with engineers, and ensure business requirements are accurately translated before development starts.
* Identify technical debt, performance issues, or architectural risks in the ERP footprint and flag them proactively with the engineering team.
* Define and track adoption and utilization KPIs per module (active users, transactions captured in\-system vs. outside, automation rate, exception rate, error rate, days\-to\-close, etc.).
* Build enablement materials, SOPs, training, and runbooks for finance users — ensure that what we deliver is actually used.
* Monitor usage data, surface adoption blockers, and run targeted interventions (training refreshers, UX tweaks, configuration changes) to lift utilization.
* Be the dedicated ERP–Finance partner to the Finance leadership team and their team members.
* Translate finance language into technical requirements and engineering language into business\-readable updates.
* Run a regular operating rhythm with Finance: weekly working sessions, monthly steering, quarterly roadmap reviews.
* Ensure the ERP is the single source of truth for finance data — and that reports, dashboards, and reconciliations pull from it correctly.
* Partner with Finance and Internal Audit on access controls, segregation of duties, audit trails, and compliance configurations within the ERP.
* Support month\-end and year\-end close by removing system blockers and ensuring data integrity.
* Maintain comprehensive, up\-to\-date documentation of the ERP–Finance footprint: configurations, customizations, integrations, workflows, and decisions made.
* Contribute to the team's knowledge base (Notion, Confluence) so the role and the system are not dependent on any single individual.
* Onboard new finance users with a structured curriculum and reference materials.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
* 5–8 years of experience in project management, ERP, Finance Systems, Business Analysis, or Digital Transformation — with at least 3 years working hands\-on with an ERP in a finance or cross\-functional context.
* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end projects: scope definition, stakeholder alignment, delivery, UAT, go\-live, and outcome measurement.
* Strong functional knowledge of finance and accounting concepts: GL, AP, AR, fixed assets, multi\-currency, multi\-company, intercompany, tax, reconciliation, and financial close.
* Demonstrated experience identifying ERP gaps, scoping improvements, leading delivery, and driving adoption with finance teams.
* Solid technical literacy — comfortable reading system specs, understanding integrations, APIs, and data flows, reviewing configurations with engineers, and making informed scope and priority decisions.
* Strong product\-owner / business\-analyst skill set — discovery, requirements documentation, user stories, UAT, success measurement.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to push back constructively and align senior finance and tech leaders.
* Working proficiency with Jira, Notion, Miro, and basic productivity tools.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems — particularly the Accounting, Invoicing, Payments, Reporting modules, etc.
* Experience with ERP version migrations or upgrades on live systems.
* Exposure to high\-growth, multi\-entity, multi\-currency environments — ideally in tech, e\-commerce, fintech, or super\-app companies.
* Familiarity with payment gateway integrations, bank connectors, and reconciliation automation.
* Experience working embedded in or alongside a software engineering team — understanding the development lifecycle, sprint ceremonies, and technical trade\-offs.
* Process improvement background (Lean / Six Sigma / Agile).


**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; an MBA or equivalent is welcome.
* CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent finance certification.
* PMP, Agile, or product management certifications.
* Arabic language skills.

**Description**
**About the role**
 Qatar Airways are pleased to announce an incredibly exciting opportunity to join our Distribution team as a Commercial Efficiency Manager (Payments) to be based in Doha, Qatar.
   

  

 As a Commercial Efficiency Manager (Payments), you will own the commercial payment strategy and operational framework for Qatar Airways' indirect distribution channels; ensuring that payment method acceptance, cost of sale management, policy governance, and payment programme performance across indirect channels are delivered with commercial discipline and measurable efficiency. You will also be responsible for developing and maintaining the indirect channel payment roadmap, driving the adoption of preferred payment methods, monitoring payment\-related costs, and ensuring that all payment policies and processes across indirect channels are clearly defined, consistently enforced, and continuously improved. In this role you will work in close coordination with the Manager Payments for the direct channel and the Head of Payments in Finance to maintain a coherent, cross\-channel view of Qatar Airways' payment economics, while holding clear primary ownership of the indirect channel.
   

  

**Specific Responsibilities For The Role Include**
* Define and maintain the indirect channel payment strategy by establishing Qatar Airways' commercial position on payment method acceptance, preferred payment method prioritisation, cost of sale targets, and payment policy frameworks across GDS, NDC, aggregator, and other indirect connect channels; ensuring alignment with the broader commercial direction.
* Develop and own the indirect channel payment roadmap by identifying, prioritizing, and sequencing payment capability improvements, new payment method introductions, and legacy method rationalization across indirect channels; grounded in sound business cases with clear commercial outcomes, measurable ROI, and realistic delivery timelines, in full coordination with market and segment owners.
* Monitor and manage Qatar Airways' payment cost of sale across indirect channels on a continuous basis by tracking payment method costs, acquirer fees, scheme charges, and processing costs by channel and market; producing regular, accurate reporting that gives the Commercial and Finance teams a clear view of payment economics, cost trends, and variance against target.
* Drive the adoption of preferred and lower\-cost payment methods across indirect channels by working with trade partners, distribution partners, and channel owners to actively shift the payment mix towards methods that improve Qatar Airways' net revenue position and reduce distribution cost of sale over time.
* Own and maintain the indirect channel payment policy framework by defining, documenting, and enforcing payment acceptance policies, surcharging rules, local payment method guidelines, and agency payment terms across all indirect distribution channels while ensuring policies are consistently applied across markets and regularly reviewed for commercial relevance and compliance.
* Coordinate and manage business cases for all payment\-related investment and change initiatives; including new payment method implementations, acquirer contract changes, technology upgrades, and cost optimisation programmes while ensuring all proposals are commercially justified, financially modelled, and presented with clear recommendations.
* Coordinate with finance on subjects related to acquirers and payment service providers; supporting contractual reviews, RFP processes, and commercial negotiations while ensuring that acquirer relationships and contract terms reflect Qatar Airways' commercial objectives and cost targets.
* Manage agency payment processes and policy compliance across indirect channels; including agency payment terms, ADM\-related payment disputes, and breach management by ensuring that trade partner payment behaviour is monitored, non\-compliance is addressed promptly, and corrective action is tracked through to resolution.
* Work with Finance on payment fraud prevention and cost protection by coordinating fraud monitoring, recovery mechanism implementation, and payment card fee optimization; ensuring that fraud\-related risks and costs are actively managed and do not erode the commercial efficiency of indirect channel payment operations.
* Support the activation of new destinations and distribution channels from a payment readiness perspective by assessing local payment method requirements, provisioning appropriate payment options, and ensuring payment infrastructure is in place before commercial launch.


**Be part of an extraordinary story**
 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future, and build the life you want while being part of an international community. Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 The successful candidate will have the following skills and qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics or related field with minimum 7 years of job\-related experience.
* Experience in payments, commercial strategy, airline distribution, or financial operations within aviation, travel, or e\-commerce environments.
* Proven experience managing payment strategy, cost optimisation, and commercial performance across multiple channels (GDS, NDC, aggregators, or similar ecosystems).
* Experience with financial modelling, dashboards, and performance tracking tools (Excel, Power BI, Tableau).
* Experience building business cases with ROI modelling and financial forecasting.
* Strong knowledge of global payment ecosystems, including card schemes, alternative payment methods, acquirers, PSPs, and settlement processes.
* Deep understanding of payment cost drivers.
* Strong understanding of agency payment flows, settlement processes, and industry standards.
* Strong analytical skills with ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Strong commercial acumen with ability to drive payment method adoption strategies.
* Ability to define and execute cost of sale optimisation strategies.
* Excellent command of spoken and written English.


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that Country’s Corporate Bank Business is optimally managed with the appropriate levels of co\-ordination between the constituent parts of the unit. This includes ensuring that, revenue potential is realized in a cost effective, low risk manner. The target client portfolio is developed in line with QNB’s stated strategic intent and, maximum revenue potential of relationship officers is realized via effective coaching, training and communication.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective departmental/ unit heads and monitor exercise of the same
* Implement the bank’s approved strategy / plan to facilitate achievement of related short and long term business goals in the most effective and efficient manner.
* Oversee the development and subsequent implementation of annual plans by the individual departments / functions comprising Corporate Banking to ensure achievement of pre\-set targets / objectives, including but not limited to business growth and expansion.
* Approve / amend Key Performance Indicators for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Corporate Banking Division and systematic monitoring of their achievements in terms of assets and liabilities.
* Manage the development and subsequent implementation of market best practices across all activities / operations comprising the Corporate and Institution Banking Department to promote efficiencies in work processes, ultimately resulting in increased customer satisfaction.
* Review / analyse the Corporate and Institution Banking Department management accounts (comprising the balance sheet, income statement along with the budgeted figures) on a monthly basis and positively address adverse variances noted with the respective departmental / function heads.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure the provision of value added corporate products and services to existing / potential corporate banking customers who seek banking relationships with the bank.
* Endeavour to enhance, maintain and deepen relationships with existing corporate customer base, as well as building new relationships. Ensure, by monitoring the performance of the country FI / GSF / GTB resource, that the FI customer base is developed in accordance with approved country/regional strategy for FI’s / GTB and GSF.
* Oversee the implementation and constant enhancement of the overall customer service culture within Corporate Banking team.
* Approve Service Level Agreements with other branch divisions/ departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time, which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Maintain and enhance relationships with Central Bank / other regulators and professional firms as appropriate. Ensure the promotion of QNB’s footprint and product and service offering through professional and other relevant forums.
* Support the local development of GAM accounts where appropriate.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Responsible for establishing and maintaining sound internal control environments across Corporate Banking team.
* Ensure that the approved strategy, business plans, budgets along with the approved policies / procedures and subsequent amendments thereto are timely communicated to the respective departmental heads to the extent these relate to their areas of responsibility, to enable them to be guided by / pursue or comply with the same.
* Strive to maintain continuous compliance of the policies / procedures with prevailing practices / regulations pertaining to Corporate Banking promulgated by the respective regulators (viz. Central Bank as well as other regulators in jurisdiction).
* Resolve / address resource issues (includes labor and systems) faced by the respective departments / functions either directly or through timely coordination with other Group divisions / departments to enable them to meet their assigned targets.
* Oversee the rollout of innovative corporate banking products by the respective heads of departments / functions and monitor their performance.
* Manage, control, monitor and assume responsibility for the Corporate Banking risk profile and portfolio quality in line with the expectations of Credit Committee / Executive Committee.
* Monitor / review the Corporate Banking portfolio by segment on overall basis and by product, corporate profile, country, industry and other parameters on periodic basis to evaluate the quality and performance of the same. Ensure customer revenues accord with business and return criteria.
* Lead the development of ‘early warning systems’ that highlight possible risk deterioration in the corporate credit portfolio, in order to allow for timely corrective action. Also, monitor critical portfolio caps at required intervals and take prompt action in coordination with Credit Risk when required to uphold the quality of the portfolio.
* Responsible for overseeing the overall action plans for addressing control weaknesses or compliance issues noted by Internal Audit Department, external auditors or the Compliance function.
* Coordinate Corporate Banking marketing initiatives with other line department /groups to maximize cross\-selling and advisory services opportunities for the benefit of the client and the Group as a whole.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance as well as the function’s overall performance on a regular basis.
* Manage all administrative operational aspects of division personnel (e.g. leave schedule, training, appraisal, remuneration etc.) in accordance with established HR policies and procedures.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved staff grievances or conflicts within the team.
* Possess a superior knowledge of the corporate banking business, its products and related risks together with a good knowledge of operations and control.
* Identify areas for professional development of self and other staff.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Anti\-Bribery and Corruption, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.
* All other ad hoc duties and/or activities related to QNB that management may request of the employee from time to time


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics or Business Administration (related field of study), Masters preferred
* At least 15 years of relevant banking experience, preferably with at least 5 years at a senior managerial position in corporate banking within a highly rated international bank.
* Well\-informed of the market competitive structure, industry practices and regulations for the corporate banking segment preferably with at least 5 years’ experience in the local/ regional environment and preferably 3 years international banking experience.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

 The Systems Administrator will be part of a dynamic team supporting customers throughout the ARCENT Area of Responsibility including both U.S. and coalition personnel. This is a deployed position located at Camp Arifjan, Kuwait.
   

  

 Duty hours are 12 hours per day, 7 days per week, and are subject to local labor laws. This position also requires 24/7 on call availability, including weekends and holidays.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Administer and maintain Windows servers, desktops, and laptops as part of the overall systems architecture across multiple networks and locations.
* Manage users, groups and permissions with Active Directory.
* Administer and maintain virtual environments (VMware) and physical hosts.
* Administer and maintain storage devices (NetApp) across multiple locations.
* Utilize command line tools (PowerShell) to troubleshoot systems hardware, software, and configuration issues.
* Implement disaster recovery and COOP plans, systems, and operations in coordination with the Network team and other organizations.

* Collect, review, and store server log files to identify and remediate system issues.
* Document system configurations using Visio, PowerPoint, Word, or other tools and propose, defend, and implement system changes; coordinate \& assist cybersecurity personnel with system accreditation efforts.
* Apply security patches, IAVAs, STIGS, and updates (including operating system updates) for assigned systems.
* Assist Service Desk technicians as needed with Tier I and Tier II troubleshooting and patching of desktop systems, software (MS Office, Java, Adobe, etc), printers, and server/network related issues.
* Mentor, lead, and train junior technicians as directed.
* Participate in or lead special projects and day‐to‐day operations as needed or assigned by the site lead, including surging to alternate locations for customer requirements or to backfill personnel.

* HS Diploma/GED with 8\+ years experience; Associate’s Degree with 6\+ years experience; Bachelor’s Degree with 4\+ years experience; or Master’s Degree with 2\+ years experience
* Active Top Secret SCI required.
* Active 8570/8140 IAT II (or higher) Baseline Certification, such as: Security\+ ce.

* NetApp NCDA, VMWare VCTA, CCNA, CASP, and/or ITIL certification.

**About The Role**
 As a Business Director, you’ll lead and grow our senior client relationships in Kuwait, working with leading regional and multinational clients across the GCC. In the Middle East, Monks is rapidly expanding its footprint, and we are looking for a commercially driven, client\-obsessed leader to serve as a trusted strategic advisor to C\-suite and senior marketing leadership. **Responsibilities**

* Negotiate contracts, scopes of work, and commercial terms in collaboration with finance and operations.
* Translate complex digital marketing challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling Monks solutions.
* Champion the use of Monks' proprietary technology, AI\-powered tools, and data capabilities.
* Lead and motivate cross\-functional delivery teams, ensuring high standards of work quality.
* Mentor and develop junior client services team members while contributing to the culture in Kuwait.


**About You**
 The essentials:
   

  

  

* 10\+ years of experience in digital marketing, advertising, or MarTech, with at least 4 years in a senior client leadership role.
* Bilingual proficiency with outstanding written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven track record managing and growing large, complex accounts (ideally $1M\+ annual revenue) and comfort with P\&L and forecasting.
* Market Expertise: Culturally fluent with a deep appreciation for the nuances of doing business in the Gulf; experience in Kuwait or the broader GCC is strongly preferred.
* Strategic Depth: Deep knowledge of the digital landscape, including platforms, paid media, social, CRM, and data \& analytics.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional relationship\-building skills with the ability to operate at the board and C\-suite level.
* Leadership: A natural collaborator who can lead cross\-functional teams within a complex, matrixed global organisation.


**Not a Must, But a Plus**
* Background: Experience working within a global agency network, top\-tier consultancy, or specialised marketing technology company.
* AI \& Tech Focus: A specific passion for emerging AI\-driven tools and their application in the evolving digital landscape.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit: A mindset that actively seeks out opportunity and takes the initiative to pursue it.
* Cultural Pulse: A passion for staying on the pulse of culture and the ability to provide a strategic POV.


*At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.*
**About Monks**
 Monks is the global, digital\-first, data\-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high\-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long\-term impact.
   

  

 Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022\-25\) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020\-24\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **VP – Infrastructure, Cloud and Operations** 
 , reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. The role will lead enterprise\-wide infrastructure strategy, cloud transformation, and technology operations, ensuring a secure, scalable, and high\-performance digital foundation across Dubai Holding’s diverse portfolio.
 



  





 This is a critical leadership role driving the evolution of infrastructure from traditional operations to AI\-enabled, autonomous platforms, while ensuring strong commercial discipline, resilience, and service excellence.
 



  





 If you are ready to operate at the intersection of technology, business, and transformation, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Strategy \& Transformation** 



* Define and execute Dubai Holding’s enterprise infrastructure and cloud strategy aligned to business growth and digital ambitions
* Lead large\-scale transformation of legacy environments into modern, cloud\-native and hybrid platforms
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and policies ensuring security, scalability, and operational consistency
* Drive resilience strategies including disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure risk management



**Cloud \& Platform Leadership** 



* Lead multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments
* Oversee cloud migration, optimization, and cloud\-native adoption across business units
* Implement infrastructure\-as\-code and automation frameworks to accelerate deployment and scalability
* Build strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and leading infrastructure providers



**Operations \& Service Excellence** 



* Own end\-to\-end IT infrastructure operations and service delivery across all business units
* Implement ITIL\-aligned service management practices, including incident, change, and problem management
* Ensure 24/7 monitoring, performance optimization, and uptime across critical systems
* Establish SLAs, KPIs, and continuous improvement frameworks for operational excellence



**Commercial \& Financial Leadership** 



* Own infrastructure P\&L including total cost of ownership across on\-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Develop business cases for infrastructure investments, clearly articulating ROI and value realization
* Drive FinOps maturity, including cost transparency, showback/chargeback models, and cloud optimization strategies
* Lead negotiations with hyperscalers, telecom providers, and strategic vendors to optimize commercial outcomes
* Establish infrastructure unit economics (e.g., cost per workload, user, or transaction) to enable data\-driven decisions
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure governance, cost control, and scalable investment planning



**Network, Data Center \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee infrastructure lifecycle across compute, storage, and networking environments
* Lead network strategy including LAN, WAN, and connectivity across multiple assets and locations
* Drive virtualization, containerization, and platform optimization initiatives
* Ensure robust infrastructure security and performance across all environments



**Agentic AI\-Ready Infrastructure** 



* Architect AI\-native infrastructure platforms supporting large\-scale deployment of AI agents and advanced workloads
* Lead transition toward autonomous operations, including self\-healing infrastructure and predictive operations
* Enable intelligent orchestration of infrastructure resources based on real\-time demand and business context
* Define strategy for GPU and compute environments supporting AI, LLMs, and advanced analytics workloads
* Establish governance, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop frameworks for AI\-driven infrastructure operations
* Drive cultural transformation toward AI\-enabled operations and reduced manual intervention



**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management** 



* Partner with executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with strategic priorities
* Manage vendor ecosystem including cloud providers, MSPs, and telecom partners
* Oversee contract negotiations, performance management, and vendor governance frameworks
* Ensure alignment with security, architecture, and governance functions across the enterprise



**Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Build and lead high\-performing infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams
* Define organization structure and capability roadmap across infrastructure and cloud functions
* Drive talent development, certifications, and future skills in cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled operations
* Foster collaboration across IT and business units to deliver integrated technology services



  





**Who we are looking for** 



* 18\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud, and operations, with significant leadership exposure in complex enterprise environments
* Proven track record in leading large\-scale infrastructure and cloud transformations
* Strong experience managing multi\-vendor ecosystems and enterprise\-scale infrastructure platforms
* Deep expertise across data centers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and network environments
* Demonstrated experience in financial management of infrastructure, including cost optimization and vendor commercial strategies
* Experience operating at executive level, influencing senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field required
* Master’s degree preferred
* Certifications in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) highly valued
* ITIL, infrastructure, or project management certifications advantageous



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Enterprise infrastructure architecture (compute, storage, networking, virtualization)
* Cloud computing platforms and hybrid/multi\-cloud strategies
* Infrastructure automation, orchestration, and IaC frameworks
* Network architecture, security, and performance management
* IT service management and ITIL practices
* Infrastructure financial management and cost optimization



  





**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking and transformation leadership
* Strong commercial and business acumen
* Executive stakeholder management and influence
* Problem solving and decision\-making in complex environments
* Ability to lead large, diverse technical teams



  





 As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.
 



  





 This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

1inch is the DeFi ecosystem building financial freedom for everyone. 1inch products help users and builders trade, hold and track digital assets \- with the self\-custody, comprehensive security and the intuitive user experience they need to unlock the potential of true crypto ownership. 1inch protocols and APIs provide core infrastructure across the DeFi industry and beyond.
   

  

**Your mission**
 As Head of IT, you will own and improve the company’s corporate IT environment so employees can work securely, efficiently, and with minimal friction.
   

  

 You will lead internal IT operations across service management, workplace technology, user access, equipment lifecycle, vendor management, and AI enablement for internal functions. Your role is to ensure core IT services are reliable, scalable, and well governed, while balancing user experience, security, innovation, and cost.
   

  

 You will work closely with People, Security, Finance, Legal, and department leads to support onboarding, off\-boarding, access control, procurement, and day\-to\-day IT operations across a global organisation. You will also drive adoption of AI tools that improve productivity and workflows, while establishing clear guardrails for secure, compliant, and responsible use. This role is hands\-on in execution, while also responsible for building structure, standards, and a long\-term roadmap for the internal IT landscape.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead and improve internal IT service management processes, including request handling, incident management, and SLA tracking
* Oversee workplace technology, identity and access management, collaboration systems, and end\-user support operations
* Define and maintain standards for IT tooling, lifecycle management, documentation, and process automation
* Manage procurement, provisioning, inventory tracking, and lifecycle management for company devices and IT assets
* Ensure smooth onboarding, role changes, and offboarding processes through effective access and equipment management
* Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers, including procurement, renewals, performance reviews, and escalations
* Drive adoption of approved AI tools and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency and employee productivity
* Establish governance and guardrails for AI usage, including security, compliance, access control, and acceptable use standards
* Partner cross\-functionally with People, Finance, Legal, Security, and department leaders on company\-wide IT initiatives
* Build and develop the internal IT function, including prioritisation, operational planning, and capability development


**Who You Are**
* 10\+ years of experience in corporate IT, workplace technology, internal IT, or IT operations roles, including leadership responsibilities
* Proven experience scaling internal IT support and service management operations within growing technology organisations
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, endpoint lifecycle management, SaaS administration, and collaboration platforms
* Experience managing IT asset management, procurement workflows, and vendor relationships
* Strong track record improving IT processes, documentation, automation, and operational efficiency
* Practical experience evaluating, implementing, or governing AI tools for internal productivity or operational use cases
* Ability to balance user experience, operational reliability, security, innovation, and cost optimisation
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across People, Finance, Legal, Security, and business teams
* Hands\-on, pragmatic mindset with the ability to operate strategically while remaining execution\-focused


**Nice to haves**
* Experience working within Web3, crypto, or other fast\-scaling international technology companies
* Familiarity with MDM, SSO, zero\-touch provisioning, and device compliance practices
* Experience implementing or improving ITIL\-based service management processes
* Exposure to compliance, audit, or policy\-driven IT control environments
* Experience automating onboarding, access management, or IT support workflows


*1inch is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to evaluating all candidates on the basis of their skills, experience, and potential — regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe diverse teams build better products, and we welcome applications from all backgrounds.*
 We use AI\-assisted tools to help us review applications efficiently. These tools support our recruitment team but do not make decisions on our behalf — every application is reviewed by a person before any outcome is determined. No offer or rejection is made solely on the basis of automated processing. For full details on how we use these tools and your rights in relation to them, please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

data.jd_text:
**MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB** 




 To lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of data privacy, protection, and regulatory compliance frameworks across Mediclinic Middle East, ensuring alignment with applicable UAE data protection laws, EU GDPR requirements, and organisational governance standards. The role fulfils the responsibilities of the Data Protection Officer (DPO) and provides strategic oversight, advisory support, and assurance to the business on privacy and compliance matters.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS** 




**Privacy and Data Protection – Implement, monitor and ensure compliance with and governance of all aspects of privacy and data protection framework** 



* Maintain and improve the data protection framework including policies and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable laws such as UAE PDPL, DIFC DPL, ADGM DPR, EU\-GDPR and regulations, policies and standards from healthcare regulators such as ADHICS
* Monitor legislative and regulatory developments on privacy, data protection and other data and cyber laws and lead the implementation of requirements
* Establish and participate in appropriate governance structures in a 2nd\-line\-of\-defence role, and align with other relevant governance stakeholders such as Information Security, Legal, Risk and Internal Audit
* Design, drive and maintain privacy and data protection programs and standards to ensure a consistent practice and a continuous growth of data protection maturity in the company
* Inform senior key stakeholders about data protection responsibilities, risks and related issues
* Maintain an accountability framework for privacy and data protection, including Senior Management, Data Owners, Data Privacy Champions and other roles
* Act as the official Data Protection Officer (DPO) for Mediclinic Middle East and its subsidiaries
* Guide the business on all privacy, data protection and related matters and contribute as subject matter expert for the company
* Establish collaborative networks with internal colleagues in IT, Innovation, Operations, Business Development, Clinical and other key stakeholders to drive and assist the implementation of privacy and data protection requirements
* Manage a framework to assess and mitigate data protection risks and incidents (risk register, data protection impact assessments, personal data breaches), conduct assessments, and report issues and concerns to the relevant senior stakeholders in the company and to regulators (if applicable)
* Manage data breach incidents and support investigations and mitigation actions in cyber security and other incidents affecting personal data.
* Report data breaches to the relevant senior stakeholders in the company and to regulators (if applicable). Member of the Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT).
* Ensure awareness and training campaigns are conducted and assist in training content development to increase awareness and understanding of and compliance with the framework and laws
* Conduct regular data protection audits and spot checks to ensure compliance and to mitigate risks, and participate as auditee in internal and external audits and inspections related to privacy, data protection and information security
* Oversee and coordinate the implementation and maintenance of legally required data processing registers
* Support the Legal department and contract owners in the review of contracts and agreements and in the implementation of data protection clauses
* Maintain oversight on data security programs and measures and collaborate and align with the Information Security (InfoSec) department in the review and implementation of safeguards and measures regarding data security, data localisation and other requirements



  





**Legal Compliance – Drive the regulatory compliance strategy and culture** 



* Implement and maintain the Regulatory Compliance policy and drive the compliance program
* Monitor legal and regulatory developments over all applicable jurisdictions for significant developments impacting the company’s risk exposure, ownership and structure, licensing, finances and taxes, and other operations (except clinical and medical)
* Re\-assess the compliance and regulatory risks for reporting to internal stakeholders and shareholders
* Ensure regulatory compliance is driven as an integrated part of the enterprise risk management process. This includes the execution and regular updating of compliance assessments for all key functional / business areas in each platform
* Facilitate the embedding of compliance processes into the functional / business areas and ensure managers execute on their compliance plans
* Stay abreast of and continuously monitor top compliance and regulatory updates and changes relevant to the business
* Provide training on Mediclinic compliance framework



  





**Leadership – Provide oversight and assurance to the business** 



* Implement and execute goals, objectives, policies and directions given from Group and senior leadership, and prepare and execute a year plan and programs for privacy, data protection and legal compliance according to Group and Divisional objectives and priorities
* Lead, guide and manage the team
* Lead the network of Data Privacy Champions, including chairing the Data Privacy Committee, develop the skills and expertise of the Champions and provide operational support
* Prepare regular and required feedback reports for submission to Board, EXCO, OPSCO or other relevant governance structures on the status of data protection and regulatory compliance matters
* Participate in and contribute to relevant forums and committees as required by the company’s needs and as per assignment
* Establish and proactively participate in networks with external experts in relation to privacy and data protection



  





**ESSENTIAL MINIMUM EXPERIENCE** 



* At least 5 years’ experience in Privacy and Data Protection within Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Risk Management, or Data Governance functions, with demonstrated experience in implementing and managing privacy compliance frameworks and data protection programmes.
* Experience in data protection and regulatory compliance within a complex corporate environment, including engagement with executive and senior stakeholders. Experience within the healthcare sector and/or GCC regulatory environment is highly advantageous.
* Certification in compliance, information security, or risk management is also advantageous.



  





**ESSENTIAL EDUCATION** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Information Technology, Computer Science, Commerce, Risk Management, Information Security, or a related field.
* Professional certification in Data Privacy or Information Governance from recognized institutions such as IAPP (CIPP/E, CIPM), ISACA, ISO, or equivalent.



  





**REQUIRED JOB SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE** 



* Data privacy and data protection laws, regulations, and practices
* Compliance, governance, and risk management frameworks and methodologies
* Strategic business and operational acumen
* UAE and international legal/regulatory environments
* IT systems, data flows, and organisational governance structures
* Healthcare industry operations and related regulatory requirements
* Incident management, breach response, and remediation processes
* Compliance monitoring and corrective action management
* Third\-party/vendor risk and data processing governance
* Training, awareness, and compliance culture development
* Project management and change management principles
* Reporting, analytics, and governance dashboard preparation
* Verbal and written communication skills
* Coaching, mentoring, and team leadership capability
* Stakeholder management and relationship building
* Collaboration and cross\-functional partnership

 Ready to make your mark? Apply now to lead quality excellence at Hologic!

We are seeking an exceptional
 **Head of Treasury** 
 to join our executive leadership team. This is a high\-impact role with direct accountability for restructuring and optimising the Group's debt capital structure, leading syndicated loan facilities with international banks, and building a world\-class treasury function that supports our multi\-vertical, multi\-geography growth strategy.
 



 The successful candidate will serve as the Group's primary interface with international banking partners, credit rating agencies, and institutional investors across diverse and often complex operating jurisdictions — ensuring robust liquidity management, financial risk governance, and regulatory compliance at both group and subsidiary level.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




***Debt Restructuring \& Capital Structure***




 ● Lead end\-to\-end debt restructuring initiatives, optimising the company's capital structure to reduce cost of debt and improve financial flexibility.
 



 ● Develop and execute debt management strategies including refinancing, covenant renegotiation, and balance sheet deleveraging.
 



 ● Oversee the full lifecycle of corporate borrowing facilities, ensuring alignment with business strategy and board\-approved leverage targets.
 



 ● Present debt strategy recommendations to the Holding CEO, Board, and Audit \& Risk Committee.
 



  





***Syndicated Loans \& International Banking Relationships***




 ● Lead the structuring, negotiation, and execution of syndicated loan facilities and bilateral credit agreements with international banking partners.
 



 ● Serve as the primary point of contact for the company's relationship banks, maintaining strong partnerships across global financial institutions.
 



 ● Manage the documentation process for loan agreements in collaboration with legal counsel and external advisors.
 



 ● Monitor compliance with loan covenants and proactively manage lender communications.
 



  





***Liquidity \& Cash Management***




 ● Oversee global cash management, liquidity forecasting, and working capital optimisation across all group entities.
 



 ● Implement and maintain a robust cash pooling structure to maximise internal efficiency and minimise external borrowing.
 



 ● Ensure the company maintains adequate liquidity buffers and committed facilities to meet operational and strategic needs.
 



  





***Risk Management \& Hedging***




 ● Design and implement hedging strategies to mitigate FX, interest rate, and commodity price risks in line with the Board\-approved risk appetite.
 



 ● Manage relationships with derivative counterparties and oversee ISDA documentation.
 



 ● Maintain compliance with treasury risk policies and financial reporting standards (IFRS 9 / hedge accounting).
 



  





***Governance, Reporting \& Strategy***




 ● Develop, implement, and enforce treasury policies, controls, and governance frameworks.
 



 ● Produce high\-quality treasury reporting for the Board, CFO, and external stakeholders including credit rating agencies.
 



 ● Support M\&A activity, capital raises, and other strategic finance initiatives from a treasury perspective.
 



 ● Lead, develop, and mentor the treasury team, fostering a high\-performance culture.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:**




***Essential***




 ● 18\+ years of progressive treasury experience, with at least 8 years in a senior treasury leadership role within a large corporate environment.
 



 ● Proven track record of leading complex debt restructuring programmes and/or refinancing transactions.
 



 ● Demonstrated experience negotiating and closing syndicated loan facilities with international banks.
 



 ● Deep expertise in cash management, liquidity risk, FX hedging, and interest rate risk management.
 



 ● Strong working knowledge of financial instruments, capital markets, and credit documentation (LMA standard preferred).
 



 ● Professional qualification: ACT (AMCT/MCT), CFA, ACA/ACCA, or equivalent.
 



 ● Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline.
 



***Desirable***




 ● Proficiency with SAP TRM; familiarity with other treasury management systems is an advantage
 



 ● Experience operating within a large conglomerate or diversified holding group, with exposure to multiple business verticals and subsidiaries, preferably including contracting or infrastructure businesses.
 



 ● Prior exposure to treasury operations spanning the GCC, MENA, Africa, Central Asia, or frontier markets — experience in markets such as KSA, Iraq, Libya, Kazakhstan, or similar is a strong advantage.
 



 ● Background in managing treasury across diverse and complex operating jurisdictions, including countries with capital controls, currency restrictions, or limited banking infrastructure.
 



 ● Familiarity with ESG\-linked financing instruments (green bonds, sustainability\-linked loans).
 



 ● Exposure to high\-yield debt markets or leveraged finance structures.
 



 ● Experience interfacing with group\-level governance, intercompany treasury arrangements, and intra\-group lending frameworks across multiple sectors.
 



  





**Leadership \& Competencies**




 ●Strategic Thinking — Ability to translate complex financial dynamics into clear, actionable treasury strategies.
 



 ● Executive Presence — Credible and confident in presenting to Boards, rating agencies, and senior banking partners.
 



 ● Negotiation Skills — Track record of delivering favourable terms in complex, multi\-party banking negotiations.
 



 ● Risk Mindset — Disciplined approach to identifying, quantifying, and mitigating financial risk.
 



 ● People Leadership — Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high\-performing teams.
 



 ● Integrity \& Governance — Highest standards of professional conduct and financial controls.
 



  





 \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
 



**About the Group** 




 Estithmar Holding is a Qatar\-based diversified investment holding group operating across five core business verticals: Infrastructure \& Contracting Ventures, Property Development, Hospitality \& Healthcare, Financial Services, and a Services Group encompassing Manpower, Facilities Management, and Catering. With an active and growing footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, and beyond — including operations in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Libya, Syria, Kazakhstan, Rwanda, the Maldives, Albania, Algeria, Egypt, and Venezuela — the Group manages a complex, multi\-currency portfolio of businesses and investments requiring sophisticated treasury leadership

data.jd_text:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a role that will help you stand out at HSBC, take a look at how you can fulfil your potential.
   

  

 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
   

  

 Credit \& Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit \& Lending (C\&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as a Country Head of CCM Services \& Lead BCO.
   

  

**In This Role You Will Be Responsilbe For**
* Ensuring CCM OKRs are achieved for their respective market
* Leading the execution and implementation of the BCO function, to efficiently manage the underwriting process across country CIB. The BCO function to be globally leading across the bank, leveraging organizational design capabilities to optimize processes and structures.
* Taking a lead in managing the portfolio and risk exposure partnering with banking teams and WCRM to determine and monitor risk appetite
* Driving policy and procedure simplification / optimization to make the underwriting process more effective with a focus on value\-add activities and creating risk differentiated processes
* Continuously focus on improving the productivity of the function whilst enhancing client experience
* Providing oversight to outsourced credit \& capital management services
* Landing an ambitious multi\-year transformation journey within their market
* Implementing the Target CCM Services Operating Model and delivering financial targets associated with its’ implementation in the market
* Leading risk and control management across the end\-to\-end process
* Manage CCM COO FRP, budgeting and planning processes for the market
* Land locally the transformation and digitisation of the CCM COO journey and lead local initiatives to improve and re\-engineer processes for the market
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback, identifying key areas of focus to significantly improve customer outcomes for the market
* Represent CCM Services in front of market stakeholders and at market forum
* Unify and provide direction to a dislocated set of smaller teams, fostering a sense of unity and purpose and embed the Target CCM services operating model
* Develop and maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.
* Oversee and execute the delivery of CCM services in\-country (where required), ensuring alignment with regional processes and a seamless and efficient process for customers
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback within the market, identifying local areas of focus to improve customer outcomes while ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders, including technology, CCM, WCRM, Legal, the global business Coverage teams, digital channels and products to implement the overall strategy for the wholesale credit and lending journey.
* Implement governance frameworks to ensure risks and issues related to the Credit \& Lending journey are escalated to regional, and global stakeholders and resolved in a satisfactory manner. Monitor the management of financial and non\-financial risks pertaining to the CCM production in partnership with local NFR/Business Risk.
* Act as the local Business Service Owner for Credit \& Lending across CIB, ensuring service resilience. Manage and execute local end\-to\-end processes for Credit \& Lending on behalf of the CIB Business. Monitor and manage local risk and controls across the end\-to\-end controls, meeting all SOX obligations.
* Support the OKR, KPI and SLA management framework within the market, maintaining service management oversight pertaining to both operational and control performance across all CCM CTB \& RTB services end\-to\-end.
* Collaborate with the CCMS Product, Design and Innovation Pillar, technology and transformation teams to execute the technology strategy for CCM, reduce legacy technologies, and drive a culture of innovation by developing cutting\-edge automation, capability, and business solutions leveraging next\-gen technologies, AI, and analytics.
* Manage multiple senior stakeholders with varied and sometimes conflicting agendas, effectively navigating complex situations and driving alignment.
* Maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.


**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**
* Extensive years of experience in wholesale credit and lending, with a strong background in coverage, credit management or operations
* Proven track record of leading and managing teams, with experience in organizational design and strategic planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders.
* Expertise in credit risk management, control assessment, and SOX compliance.
* Experience in driving digitisation and customer experience improvement initiatives.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to consume large volumes of customer feedback and distil key areas of focus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Great team player with a positive attitude, energy and enthusiasm.
* Promote a collective culture to spread experience and best practice and live the Group Values.
* Give timely, honest and constructive feedback to others.
* Promotes innovative and lateral thinking approach for devising solutions.
* Bring thought leadership and governance around the internal and external lending ecosystem.
* Deliver fair outcome for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.
* Highly effective communication skills (oral, written and presentational)
* Ability to work accurately and achieve tight deadlines with limited supervision
* Self\-motivation, and a proven rapid learning capability in a changing environment are essential
* Committed to personal and professional development


 You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
   

  

 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.
